SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, TO_CHAR(KEY_3) AS LEGACY_GR_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_4) AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') GROUP BY KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'MOTR' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, NVL(PLANT,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(KEY_2,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(GR_QTY, 0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(GR_AMT, 0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, NVL(KEY_3,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(KEY_4,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION, 0) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM V_KEP_GR, KEPTRXL WHERE KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO(+) AND KEY_2 = LEGACY_PO_SEQ(+) AND KEY_3 = LEGACY_GR_NO(+) AND KEY_4 = LEGACY_GR_SEQ(+) AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') AND DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN' ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2,KEY_3,KEY_4
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), KEY_5 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','T') AND DOC_NAME = 'GRDOWN'
